khm.text: Halvar, God of Battle, begins as an orphaned baby that Alrund finds in an eagle's nest on Axgard and adopts, leaving him as the dwarf king's ward for twenty years.

Halvar saves Koll from the monster Sarulf, and Koll swears to forge him a blade, creating the sword known as [[Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms]], but Tibalt steals the Sword before Koll can give it to Halvar.
During the Doomskar, Halvar stands alone on a bridge before a mound of destroyed draugr, defending a Bretagard village against the Dread Marn.
Kaya, helped by Tyvar, Harald and others, finally delivers the Sword to him, and Halvar completes the ritual, which seals the Doomskar, closes the rifts and banishes the undead.
